San Antonio City Clerk resolution 2025-12-18-0048R (December 18, 2025) states council terms, including the mayor, are four years, with current members holding over after June 2029 until the November 2029 election. The mayor elected in June 2025 therefore has no election in 2026. The Bexar County May 2, 2026 summary report has no City of San Antonio mayor contest.
